params.name: start
params.description: Start date of the period at 00:00:00 in local time of the customer (format yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: end
params.description: End date of the period at 23:59:59 in local time of the customer (format yyyy-mm-dd)

items.docs: Retrieve a price object for a given subscription. For a consumption subscription this is the variable price time series the customer pays and can optimize consumption against; for a feed-in subscription it is the payout the customer is credited per kWh, based on EPEX day-ahead spot prices and without grid fees. All prices are inclusive of VAT, except feed-in payouts to a VAT-exempt customer.
